principle: All Framework v2 boards that do not depend on each other's outputs shall execute in parallel. Sequential execution is the exception, not the default. This applies to: board-level agents within a session, gate-level scans within the pipeline, and per-pack processing within each gate.

rules.rule: Independent boards execute in parallel. Certification Board, Quality Board, and Throughput Board have no mutual dependencies — all three consume different sections of the same Certification Scan Artifact.
rules.enforcement: Session orchestrator launches board agents simultaneously. Convergence occurs at the Governance Board, which consumes outputs from all boards.

rules.rule: Gates within the scan pipeline execute sequentially (Gate -1 → Gate 0 → Gate 1 → Gate 2 → Gate 3 → Gate 4 → Gate 5). Scans within a gate execute in parallel.
rules.enforcement: Scan Orchestrator (S322 Script 3) enforces gate ordering. PG-001 through PG-009 (Gate 1) run in parallel. PG-010 and PG-011 (Gate 4) run in parallel.

rules.rule: Per-pack processing within each gate executes in parallel. Pack A through Pack E are independent inputs — scan modules process all 5 packs simultaneously.
rules.enforcement: Gate scan modules receive all pack arrays and process them via parallel iteration (Promise.all or equivalent).

rules.rule: Convergence boards are required for independent streams. When boards execute in parallel, a Governance Board convergence step verifies consistency across all outputs before the Deployment Authorization Board (J) issues a decision.
rules.enforcement: Governance Board runs G1-G5 reconciliation if any board output disagrees with another board's output on the same item.

small_session.scope: A-F (6 boards, single-domain scan or focused remediation)
agent_assignment: Agent 1: Scan Orchestrator (Gate -1 through Gate 4, all packs)
Agent 2: Quality Board + Certification Board (parallel — consume artifact sections 3-6)
Agent 3: Governance Board + Throughput Board (parallel — consume artifact sections 1-2, 7-9)
small_session.convergence: Agent 3 (Governance) reconciles Quality and Certification outputs

medium_session.scope: A-L (12 boards, full certification wave or multi-domain audit)
agent_assignment: Agent 1: Scan Orchestrator (Gate -1 through Gate 4, all packs)
Agent 2: Registry Board (artifact generation + delta ledger update)
Agent 4: Certification Board (READY items only per R6)
Agent 6: Governance Board (convergence verification + rule compliance)
medium_session.convergence: Agent 6 (Governance) runs G1-G5 reconciliation across Agents 2-5 outputs

large_session.scope: A-Z (26 agents, full repository audit or migration event)
agent_assignment: Agent 1: Scan Orchestrator (Gate -1 through Gate 4, all 5 packs in parallel)
Agents 2-3: Registry Board (artifact validation + lineage verification)
Agents 4-5: Quality Board (parallel — split by pack: A-C, D-E)
Agents 6-7: Certification Board (parallel — split by section: A-B, C-F)
Agent 10: Administration Board (challenge workbench + RBAC validation)
Agent 12: Governance Board (convergence + G1-G5 + G-NEW rules compliance)
large_session.convergence: Agent 12 (Governance) reconciles all board outputs. Any discrepancy triggers sub-agent investigation.

convergence_board_protocol.trigger: Any session with 3+ parallel board agents
execution: Governance Board agent collects all board outputs
Runs G1 (count audit) — do all boards agree on item counts, certified counts, defect counts?
Runs G2 (state audit) — do all boards agree on question_state assignments?
Runs G3 (defect audit) — do all boards agree on defect classifications?
Runs G4 (hash audit) — do all boards reference the same artifact version?
Runs G5 (recommendation audit) — do all boards agree on active REC-IDs?
convergence_board_protocol.resolution: If all G1-G5 pass → proceed to Deployment Authorization Board. If any G1-G5 fail → halt and escalate per escalation paths.
convergence_board_protocol.escalation: Same escalation paths defined in S205 Hybrid Mode Operations (Board D): hash_mismatch (CRITICAL), scan_artifact_corruption (HIGH), readiness_disagreement (MEDIUM), recommendation_conflict (LOW).

anti_patterns_prohibited: Forcing single-agent sequential execution when boards have no mutual dependencies
Running per-pack scans sequentially when packs are independent inputs
Skipping convergence step after parallel board execution
Spawning duplicate agents for the same scan on the same pack (R8 violation)
Having certification board agents perform their own scans (R8 violation)

activation_verdict.verdict: ACTIVATED — V2-PAR-001 Parallel By Default is now the standard execution protocol for all Framework v2 sessions.
activation_verdict.conditions: None. The standard is immediately effective for S206 and all subsequent sessions.
activation_verdict.confidence: HIGH — S204 pilot demonstrated correct parallel execution of 9 boards without conflict.
